indices.title: Overnight index moves and breadth
indices.body: Nasdaq: +0.35% · S&P 500: +0.30% · VIX: −0.32% (figures as supplied; observation time and quote source not provided). The note says broader participation is needed for a sustained rally and flags rate expectations as a key factor. It also reports Polymarket at about 66% for no rate change after PCE; the specific contract and capture time were not supplied, so treat that figure as unverified. Today is also the final trading day of September and the third quarter.
